campaign_name: PR-BR Continuation 20 — Incidental Entity Binding and Intent-Preserving Abstention
purpose: Bind ordinary plausible incidental people through PR-BN, and keep the player's operation and dimension when entity or claim binding fails. Four focused live turns. No independent smoke. No 4x10 gate. PR-BR remains open.
executive_summary: C18's seal-or-retry lifecycle and C19's hard-authority boundary are unchanged. A proposed ordinary person in a populated scene can become a minimal incidental entity under PR-BN. Consequential and implausible references are not instantiated, and a failed explicit addressee does not restore the previous NPC. Source inquiry stays source when no claim is bound. The 281-test band passed. Four live turns bound a canonical runner, then the same porter, kept a source follow-up, and inspected the notice. Exact accepted text 4/4. READY FOR ANOTHER INDEPENDENT 10-TURN SMOKE: YES. READY FOR FULL SYNTHETIC GATE: NO. HUMAN PLAYTEST: NOT AUTHORIZED. HEAD d31beb7d73dd4fda0f22184a6a69b947b5f470ff, uncommitted.
